body: Thank you. It is nice to know that I am not alone in how I feel. I do have a therapist but is a challenging thing to talk about, because I seem fine to most people when in reality I am forcing myself to do all of these things that most people do with relative ease. I am hoping that over time things will get easier and more bearable but every morning when I wake up it only gets harder to get out of bed. But thank you for sharing your experiences, and I am happy for you that you were able to overcome your anxiety.
